payload.title: M3: Interactive sessions — SSE output and POST input
payload.description: Intent: As the student, I want to type into a running program and see output as it appears, so that interactive programs behave like a terminal. Includes: pty-backed process in the runner, GET /events (Server-Sent Events) with resumable output buffer, POST /stdin, run/stop controls, idle self-shutdown. Excludes: WebSockets, AppSync, ALB. DoD: Gherkin specs show prompt/response programs working end to end, reconnect resumes without losing output, idle session exits.
